lines.metroidvania.item.boots.how: PRESS {key:jump} AGAIN IN THE AIR: A SECOND JUMP
lines.metroidvania.recharged.how: A RECHARGE STATION: IT DOES NOT SAVE
lines.metroidvania.hint.touch: STICK MOVES AND AIMS  •  FIRE BESIDE A FOE: THE LASH  •  MAP
lines.metroidvania.hint.keys: {key:jump} JUMP  •  {key:fire} FIRE (HOLD)  •  {key:melee} LASH  •  HOLD {key:lock} AIM  •  {key:map} MAP
lines.metroidvania.map.key: S SAVE ROOM   B A BOSS   {key:map} CLOSES

notes.metroidvania.room.landing: The rooms' names (metroidvania.room.*) show in a band as the hero first enters each, and on the map.
notes.metroidvania.boss.carapace: A boss: a giant armored beetle. Its name shows over its health bar.
notes.metroidvania.boss.warden: The last boss: a huge shelled creature with one eye, guarding the reactor.
notes.metroidvania.item.boots: An ability found: boots that give a second jump in the air. Shown large when found, and on the map.
notes.metroidvania.item.boots.how: Under the item's name when found; {key:jump} is the jump key or button.
notes.metroidvania.item.dash: An ability found: a quick dash that passes through the blue hatches (doors).
notes.metroidvania.item.dash.how: Under the item's name when found; {key:dash} is the dash key or button.
notes.metroidvania.item.tank: A pickup that raises the suit's most energy by 100.
notes.metroidvania.saved.how: Under GAME SAVED, on stepping onto the save station.
notes.metroidvania.touch.lash: A touch button's label: the energy whip, offered beside a foe. Short.
notes.metroidvania.hud.energy: Short for ENERGY, before the energy number in the corner: two letters.
notes.metroidvania.hud.boots: Tiny label under the energy: the spring boots, once found.
notes.metroidvania.hud.dash: Tiny label under the energy: the phase dash, once found.
notes.metroidvania.hint.touch: Controls hint on a touch screen: the stick moves and aims, the FIRE button beside a foe uses the lash (an energy whip), and the MAP button. Three hints separated by a dot.
notes.metroidvania.hint.keys: Controls hint: five keys and what they do, separated by a dot; LASH: a short energy whip; AIM: hold to stand still and aim.
notes.metroidvania.won.score: At the end: the share of the map explored, and the items found of all there are.
notes.metroidvania.map.explored: {room} is the room the hero is in (one of the room names); then the share of the map seen.
notes.metroidvania.map.key: The map's key: S marks the save room and B a boss's room (the map draws those two letters as they are); then the key that closes the map.
notes.action.melee: The lash's name on the controls screen: a short energy whip.
notes.action.lock: Its name on the controls screen: hold it to stand still and aim.

brief: The metroidvania slice: in the manner of Metroid and Super Metroid, a lone explorer in a powered suit with an arm cannon (a person of unknown sex, never named or seen without the suit) explores a research station buried in a moon, room by room, finding abilities that open new gates. Its words are terse, technical, sci-fi notices in capitals, like an old console game's: room names, item banners, the map, the bosses' names. Nobody speaks.
